moments.title: Premier League returns for Matchweek 6
moments.blurb: The Premier League is back after the international break with a packed Matchweek 6, featuring Arsenal vs Leeds and Man Utd vs Tottenham today, and Liverpool vs Man City tomorrow.

angles.name: Saturday Kick-off
angles.copy: Premier League is BACK! Arsenal kick things off against Leeds today, then Man Utd host Tottenham later. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Sunday Big Game
angles.copy: Tomorrow's HUGE Premier League clash: Liverpool take on Manchester City at Anfield. Can City maintain their perfect start? Tune in!

angles.name: Weekend Football Buzz
angles.copy: Matchweek 6 is underway! Plenty of goals and drama expected across the Premier League this weekend. What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Week 3
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing returns tonight for Week 3 on BBC One, with celebrities and their professional partners performing new routines, ahead of tomorrow's results show.

angles.name: Tonight's Show
angles.copy: It's Saturday night, which means it's Strictly time! Who are you excited to see on the dancefloor tonight? No theme this week, so anything goes!

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are shaking things up as the new Strictly hosts this series. What do you think of the new line-up?

angles.name: Looking Ahead to Icons Week
angles.copy: Next week is 'Icons Week' on Strictly! Which legendary artist or figure would you love to see a celebrity emulate in their routine?

moments.title: Taylor Swift lands new UK #1 single
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift has scored a new UK Official Singles Chart number one with 'Patient Zero', leading a chart featuring several new entries and a strong female presence.

angles.name: New Chart Topper
angles.copy: Taylor Swift reigns supreme on the Official UK Singles Chart with her new track 'Patient Zero'! What a week for Swifties!

angles.name: Chart Round-up
angles.copy: Beyond Taylor Swift's new #1, the charts are buzzing with new entries from Drake and Noah Kahan, plus big hits from Olivia Rodrigo and Jamie Miller. What's on your playlist right now?

angles.name: Female Power in Charts
angles.copy: For the second time in chart history, the UK Top 6 singles are all by female artists! Big up Taylor Swift, Ella Langley, Stella Lefty, ADÉLA, Dua Lipa and Olivia Rodrigo.

moments.title: Great British Bake Off continues Tuesday
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off continues this Tuesday at 8pm on Channel 4, with the latest batch of amateur bakers tackling new challenges in the tent.

angles.name: Bake Off Buzz
angles.copy: Tuesday night means more Bake Off! Who are you rooting for in the tent this year? Expect more Hollywood handshakes and maybe a few soggy bottoms.

angles.name: New Judge
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson has joined Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith as a new judge on Bake Off this series! What do you make of the new dynamic?

moments.title: Halloween preparations ramping up
moments.blurb: With Halloween falling on a Saturday this year, preparations are well underway across the UK for spooky celebrations, from theme park scarefests to home decorations.

angles.name: Spooky Season
angles.copy: Only three weeks until Halloween! Are you planning a big party, heading to a scare attraction, or keeping it cosy with a horror movie marathon?

angles.name: Pumpkin Mania
angles.copy: Pumpkins are popping up everywhere! Have you picked yours yet, or are you waiting until closer to the 31st for your carving masterpiece?

angles.name: Theme Park Frights
angles.copy: Alton Towers Scarefest and Thorpe Park Fright Nights are in full swing for Halloween! Who's brave enough for a visit this October?

moments.title: UK weather turns more autumnal
moments.blurb: The UK is transitioning to more typically autumnal weather with cooler temperatures and increased rain, although London is enjoying mild, sunny spells.

angles.name: Autumn Feels
angles.copy: It's officially feeling much more autumnal across the UK this week, with cooler air and some rain. Time for those cosy jumpers!

angles.name: London Sunshine
angles.copy: Londoners are enjoying pleasant sunny intervals and mild temperatures today, hitting 16°C. Perfect for a Saturday stroll!

angles.name: Drought Concerns
angles.copy: Despite some rain, drought conditions persist in parts of England, with reservoirs remaining exceptionally low. Every drop counts!

moments.title: Happy 72nd Birthday, David Lee Roth
moments.blurb: Today marks the 72nd birthday of the flamboyant rock legend, David Lee Roth, best known as the iconic frontman of Van Halen.

angles.name: Diamond Dave
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the one and only Diamond Dave! Still Jumpin' after all these years. What's your favourite Van Halen track?

moments.title: Happy 43rd Birthday, Lzzy Hale
moments.blurb: Wishing a very Happy 43rd Birthday to the powerhouse vocalist of Halestorm, Lzzy Hale, born today in Pennsylvania.

angles.name: Rock Queen
angles.copy: Happy 43rd Birthday to the incredible Lzzy Hale of Halestorm! Keep on rockin'!

moments.title: Happy 47th Birthday, Mya
moments.blurb: American R&B singer Mya, known for hits like 'Case of the Ex' and 'Ghetto Supastar', celebrates her 47th birthday today.

angles.name: R&B Icon
angles.copy: Happy 47th Birthday to the amazing Mya! What's your go-to Mya track for a throwback?

moments.title: Happy 68th Birthday, Tanya Tucker
moments.blurb: Country music icon Tanya Tucker, famous for 'Delta Dawn' and 'What's Your Mama's Name', turns 68 today.

angles.name: Country Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 68th Birthday to the legendary Tanya Tucker! Still sounds as good as ever.

moments.title: Happy 65th Birthday, Martin Kemp
moments.blurb: Spandau Ballet bassist and actor Martin Kemp celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: True Gold
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to Spandau Ballet's Martin Kemp! What's your favourite 80s anthem from the band?

moments.title: Happy 80th Birthday, Daryl Hall
moments.blurb: Tomorrow, rock and soul icon Daryl Hall, half of the legendary duo Hall & Oates, celebrates his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Maneater Maestro
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the incredible Daryl Hall turns 80! What's your all-time favourite Hall & Oates hit to get you moving?

moments.title: Happy 34th Birthday, Cardi B
moments.blurb: Rapper, songwriter, and television personality Cardi B celebrates her 34th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Bodak Yellow Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to wish Cardi B a very Happy 34th Birthday tomorrow! What's your favourite track from the rap queen?

moments.title: Happy 85th Birthday, Paul Simon
moments.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Paul Simon, half of the iconic duo Simon & Garfunkel, will celebrate his 85th birthday on Tuesday.

angles.name: Sound of Silence Singer
angles.copy: On Tuesday, we celebrate the 85th birthday of the incredible Paul Simon! What's your favourite song from his incredible career?

moments.title: Happy 49th Birthday, John Mayer
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter and guitarist John Mayer will turn 49 on Friday.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Friday is John Mayer's 49th Birthday! Which of his soulful tracks is your absolute favourite?

moments.title: Happy 64th Birthday, Flea
moments.blurb: Red Hot Chili Peppers bassist and co-founder Flea celebrates his 64th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Funk Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to the incredible Flea from Red Hot Chili Peppers this Friday! What's your favourite Chili Peppers bassline?

moments.title: Happy 67th Birthday, Gary Kemp
moments.blurb: Spandau Ballet guitarist and songwriter Gary Kemp will celebrate his 67th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: True Gold Songwriter
angles.copy: Friday marks the 67th Birthday of Gary Kemp, the talent behind so many Spandau Ballet hits! What's your top Spandau track?
